teaches: The seven cells after the starport are NUMBERS. A788899-C is starport A with size 7, atmosphere 8, hydrographics 8, population 8, government 9, law level 9 and tech level 12 — the pseudo-hex is a printing, and this is what is stored.
bases is a Set of closed strings, not a line of letters, and gasGiants is a count of them in the system.
sector and hex are the two halves of a location and neither is validated: a hex that is not four digits in range simply derives no coordinate.
codeOverrides is where a referee states a trade code the UWP would not have given, or takes one away.
demo.trap: berthing is null rather than 0, and the difference is real: null means the berthing cost has not been rolled yet, where 0 means it was rolled and came out free. And a codeOverrides key that is not a trade code is DROPPED with no message at all — the document loads, the sheet reads sanely, and the override is simply not there.

system.description: A wet, tidal world of shallow seas and sedge flats. Every settlement is a harbour and every harbour is an hour from open water at the wrong end of the tide.
system.notes: The harbour trust runs the starport, the patrol and the ferry, and does not distinguish between them.
